images.concept: Dark editorial scene on deep black #050505 background. CENTERED: a 3D voxel pixel-art character mascot in warm terracotta orange color (#d97856) — blocky cubic body like a Minecraft-style creature with two small rectangular black eyes, short cubic legs and small rectangular arms, matte clay-like finish with subtle 3D shading. The mascot is ACTIVELY TYPING on a small voxel laptop in front of it, the laptop screen glows amber-terracotta showing abstract lines of code/JSON, small terracotta particles float around the mascot suggesting data being processed. Behind the mascot: a radial warm terracotta-amber glow halo that fades to black at the edges. Around the mascot scene: 3-4 small voxel documents floating in orbit, each a pixelated paper with faint lines. Bottom-right corner: a small tabletop plane suggesting a desk. Top 30% of frame completely clear deep black for headline. Subtle film grain, cinematic voxel-3D render, editorial dark luxury vibe. Headline '01 BRIEF ARCHITECT' will render at top-left in matte gold with body text below. 4:5 vertical composition.
